name: How should I prepare for a bathroom door frame repair service?

mainEntity.name: How should I prepare for a bathroom door frame repair service?

acceptedAnswer.text: Before an installer arrives, clear a safe workspace inside and outside the bathroom entrance. Remove bath mats, hanging organizers, and nearby towels, and empty vanity counters close to the doorway to protect them from sawdust. If possible, note whether your door sticks more during humid summer months or right after hot showers, as this helps the technician identify seasonal swelling versus permanent settling. Knowing if you plan to replace adjacent bathroom flooring soon is also helpful, as frame cuts should match future floor heights.
acceptedAnswer.description: Clear the doorway, remove bath mats and hanging items, and clear nearby vanity counters to give the repair team clean access and room for tools.
